import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1_000_000;
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] g1, g2;
    static int[][] zdist;
    static boolean[][][][] okPair;

    static int[] dirX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static class Edge {
        int a, b, c, f;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c) {
            this.a = a;
            this.b = b;
            this.c = c;
            this.f = 0;
        }
    }

    static int totNodes, src, snk;
    static int[] lvl, it, qarr;
    static ArrayList<Edge> E;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] G;

    static void addEdge(int a, int b, int c) {
        E.add(new Edge(a, b, c));
        G[a].add(E.size() - 1);
        E.add(new Edge(b, a, 0));
        G[b].add(E.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        int h = 0, t = 0;
        qarr[t++] = src;
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        lvl[src] = 0;
        while (h < t && lvl[snk] == -1) {
            int v = qarr[h++];
            for (int id : G[v]) {
                int w = E.get(id).b;
                if (lvl[w] == -1 && E.get(id).f < E.get(id).c) {
                    qarr[t++] = w;
                    lvl[w] = lvl[v] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return lvl[snk] != -1;
    }

    static int augment(int v, int pushed) {
        if (pushed == 0) return 0;
        if (v == snk) return pushed;
        for (int i = it[v]; i < G[v].size(); ++i) {
            int id = G[v].get(i);
            int w = E.get(id).b;
            if (lvl[w] != lvl[v] + 1) continue;
            int got = augment(w, Math.min(pushed, E.get(id).c - E.get(id).f));
            if (got > 0) {
                E.get(id).f += got;
                E.get(id ^ 1).f -= got;
                it[v] = i;
                return got;
            }
        }
        it[v] = G[v].size();
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            Arrays.fill(it, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = augment(src, INF);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                ans += pushed;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean canTravel(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty) {
        if (g1[sx][sy] == 'Y' || g1[sx][sy] == 'Z' || g1[tx][ty] == 'Y' || g1[tx][ty] == 'Z')
            return false;
        int[] dist = new int[N * N];
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Deque<Integer> dq = new ArrayDeque<>();
        int start = sx * N + sy;
        dist[start] = 0;
        dq.addLast(start);
        while (!dq.isEmpty()) {
            int v = dq.removeFirst();
            int x = v / N, y = v % N;
            if (x == tx && y == ty) return true;
            if (dist[v] >= T || dist[v] >= zdist[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N) continue;
                if (g1[nx][ny] == 'Y' || g1[nx][ny] == 'Z') continue;
                int nid = nx * N + ny;
                if (dist[nid] == INF && dist[v] + 1 <= zdist[nx][ny]) {
                    dist[nid] = dist[v] + 1;
                    dq.addLast(nid);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        g1 = new char[N][N];
        g2 = new char[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            g1[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            g2[i] = s.toCharArray();
        }

        zdist = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(zdist[i], INF);

        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (g1[x][y] == 'Z') {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && g1[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            zdist[nx][ny] = 1;
                            q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.removeFirst();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dirX[d], ny = y + dirY[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && g1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && g1[nx][ny] != 'Z' && zdist[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    zdist[nx][ny] = zdist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        okPair = new boolean[N][N][N][N];
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++)
                        okPair[x1][y1][x2][y2] = canTravel(x1, y1, x2, y2);

        src = 0;
        snk = 2 * N * N + 1;
        totNodes = 2 * N * N + 2;
        lvl = new int[totNodes];
        it = new int[totNodes];
        qarr = new int[totNodes];
        E = new ArrayList<>();
        G = new ArrayList[totNodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < totNodes; i++)
            G[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] > '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(src, 1 + i * N + j, g1[i][j] - '0');
                if (g2[i][j] > '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9')
                    addEdge(N * N + 1 + i * N + j, snk, g2[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++)
                        if (okPair[x1][y1][x2][y2])
                            addEdge(1 + x1 * N + y1, N * N + 1 + x2 * N + y2, INF);

        System.out.println(dinic());
        sc.close();
    }
}
